question: Emmitt Smith passed Walter Payton as the NFL's career rushing leader in October 2002 at Texas Stadium. Which opponent was Dallas playing?
explanation: Smith broke Payton's mark of 16,726 yards with an 11-yard run against Seattle on October 27, 2002.

question: In November 2010, Michael Vick threw for four touchdowns and ran for two more as Philadelphia won 59-28 on Monday Night Football. Which team did the Eagles beat?
explanation: Vick went 20 of 28 for 333 yards with no interceptions and added 80 rushing yards at FedExField, against the team that had traded for Donovan McNabb that spring.

question: Phil Simms's season-ending foot injury against Buffalo in December 1990 handed the Giants' offense to which backup, who then beat the Bills 20-19 in the title game?
explanation: Hostetler went 20 of 32 for 222 yards and a touchdown in Super Bowl 25, while veteran backup Matt Cavanaugh did not play that season.

question: Washington moved up to No. 2 in the 2012 draft to select Robert Griffin III. Which team traded the pick away?
explanation: Washington gave the Rams first-round picks in 2012, 2013 and 2014 plus a 2012 second-rounder; its 2014 first ended up being the No. 2 overall pick.

question: After leading the NFL with a Cowboys-record 1,845 rushing yards in 2014, DeMarco Murray signed with which team in free agency?
explanation: Murray signed a five-year, $42 million deal with the division-rival Eagles, but lasted one season before Philadelphia traded him to Tennessee.

question: Victor Cruz's 99-yard touchdown catch on Christmas Eve 2011, which tied the NFL record for the longest pass play, came against which team?
explanation: Cruz gained 89 of the 99 yards after the catch in the Week 16 win, and the Giants went on to win Super Bowl 46 that season.

question: Which running back led the 2007 Super Bowl champion Giants in regular-season rushing yards?
explanation: With Tiki Barber retired, Jacobs ran for 1,009 yards in just 11 games, while Ward added 602 and rookie Bradshaw only 190.

question: Leon Lett knocked the ball loose from Thurman Thomas early in the third quarter of Super Bowl 28. Which Cowboys safety scooped it up and ran 46 yards to tie the game?
explanation: Leon Lett forced the fumble to tie it 13-13, and Washington also intercepted Jim Kelly early in the fourth quarter of Dallas's 30-13 win.

question: Alfred Morris set Washington's single-season rushing record with 1,613 yards as a 2012 rookie. In which round was he drafted?
explanation: Taken 173rd overall out of Florida Atlantic, Morris broke Clinton Portis's 2005 franchise mark of 1,516 yards.

question: Who caught Donovan McNabb's last touchdown pass of Super Bowl 39, a 30-yarder with 1:48 left that cut New England's lead to 24-21?
explanation: L.J. Smith and Westbrook had caught McNabb's first two touchdown passes, and Owens played on a surgically repaired ankle, but Lewis made the late score in the 24-21 loss.
